risk_summary: The disclosure is highly negative, documenting a Chapter 11 filing, conversion toward Chapter 7, inability to obtain operating financing, loss of a major customer contract, and efforts to sell assets at an indeterminate price. Although many financing, operating, and accounting details are quantified, repeated bankruptcy disclosures and technical accounting language partially obscure the severity of liquidity and going-concern risks.
